SR-001.justification: On T1 and T2 with the ABI capped at 1 and 2, truncate, openat read-only and no-access with O_TRUNC fail with EPERM and openat2 with ENOSYS, every outside file keeps its content, and writing plus set_len inside the workspace work; at ABI 3 Landlock refuses them (EACCES). With the guard disabled the canary fails (all four routes succeed).

SR-002.justification: On T2 (and T1) at capped ABIs 1, 2, 3, 5 and 8 a workspace write works, an outside write fails with EACCES, UDP and TCP sockets and ptrace fail with EPERM.

SR-003.justification: Capped at ABI 5 SelfAndChildren is a gap naming signals-self-and-children; at ABI 8 it refuses a signal to an outside process (EPERM); only SameUser delivers it; macOS r25 shows the hard-deny class still applies to SameUser.

SR-004.justification: A cap of 200 reports and plans the kernel ABI (8); a cap of 0 is Unsupported::Landlock { abi 0, needed 1 }; the r31 and matrix tests assert Cage::landlock_abi equals the cap, and one value feeds the tier check, lowering and ruleset (src/linux/mod.rs Cage::with_options).

SR-005.justification: The Kernels table states the truncation guard and its side effect (ABI 3), passed IP sockets on T2 (ABI 4) and unscoped signals with SameUser (ABI 6); the lowering table states both tiers' minimum, the guard and the signals-same-user row; THREAT_MODEL lists the limits and R-31.
